name: Vicious Whipout
description: Throw the dart in a rising spiral so it arrives from above the guard and not from the front.

name: Levering Cordknot
description: Two loops of cord settle one after the other over a wrist so a single tug cannot slip free.

name: Ducking Dartneck
description: Let the cord run out through the hand as the body steps back and then close the grip.

name: Resolute Cordlength
description: Cross the cord before the chest to turn a downward chop aside.

name: Stern Reelin
description: A pulse of qi gathered in the dart's point lets it pierce a leather jerkin at the end of the throw.

name: Scudding Retrieve
description: Anchor the dart in a beam or tree trunk and spring across a short gap on the taut cord.

name: Gripping Cordloop
description: Toss a sliding noose over the opponent's shoulder or arm and let it run closed as they pull.

name: Tineswerve
description: Stoop under a loop flung at the head and rise inside it with the dart already swinging.

name: Gagging Flickhand
description: Pass the dart behind the back from hand to hand so the next throw comes from the unwatched side.

name: Unmoving Tailring
description: A slapping loop of cord checks a stabbing hand just before the point arrives.

name: Entangling Loopcast
description: Lay a loop on the ground where the opponent will step and pull it shut as the foot lands.

name: Gripping Cordwinder
description: Keep a snared limb pinned against the body by holding the cord at a steady stretch.

name: Tinehasp
description: Qi runs along the cord and cinches a snared loop so the limb cannot resist a straight pull.

name: Tineflog
description: Shrug a failing loop free and cast the dart into the unguarded flank in the same breath.

name: Spiralcast Swat
description: Send the dart along a flat line with qi trailing through the cord to carry it to the target.

name: Thrumflog
description: A breath of qi on the cord bends the dart's line in the last moment of its flight.

name: Stern Dartneck
description: Call the dart home along the cord so it clips whatever stands between it and the hand.

name: Kindly Dartblade
description: Hold the cord so it hums faintly and feel the hum change when anything crosses its line.

name: Guarding Ringend
description: Slide the cord down a stiffened line of qi so a thrusting point glides off to one side.

name: Doughty Darttip
description: Qi fixes the dart on its mark so it corrects its line against a short dodge.

name: Reelinslap
description: Stiffen the cord with qi and crack it like a rod across the opponent's guard arm.

name: Brass Flickhand
description: Begin the spin of the cord at the wrist and widen it into a disk before the chest.

name: Layered Cordlength
description: Tilt the spinning cord up to knock a blow aimed at the head away from the body.

name: Hazespool
description: Drop the spinning cord toward the knees to sweep a low cut off its line.

name: Grim Snapback
description: Break from the spin and throw the dart straight out of the disk's open face.

name: Rillreelin
description: Circle to the right while the guard keeps turning so the opponent's line is always crossed.

name: Static Loopcast
description: The spinning cord snaps across a sword's flat and drags the blade out of true.

name: Sprig Dartblade
description: Qi keeps the disk turning without the arm tiring so a steady shield stands against repeated blows.

name: Tinescreen
description: Spin the cord fast enough to bat thrown darts and arrows from the air before they reach the body.

name: Thrumswat
description: Let the stored spin fly out of the guard in one hard lash across the opponent's front.

name: Brisk Cordknot
description: Throw the dart against a post so it bounces round to strike the opponent from the side.

name: Darttip Thwack
description: Glance the dart off a wall so it caroms into an opponent standing close to the same wall.

name: Recall Cordwinder
description: Listen to the rap of the dart on stone and judge from the sound where it will bounce next.

name: Recall Snapback
description: Hurl the dart at a corner so the opponent turns to meet it from the wrong side.

name: Clay Tailring
description: Take a sliding step in the dart's rebound so the body arrives where the weight will be.

name: Gleam Reelin
description: Catch the returning dart and send it out again within a single steady beat.

name: Hazetine
description: Rap the dart against an attacking wrist from below to spoil the cut before it begins.

name: Ruthless Spiralcast
description: Qi gives the dart extra spring off a hard surface so it rebounds twice before it falls.

name: Brass Whipout
description: Strike once on the throw and again on the bounce from a wall before the foe can recover.

name: Blankthrum
description: Catch the rebounding dart and fling it out again with a burst of qi that pierces light armor.

name: Embertine
description: Shorten the cord into the fist and strike with the dart swinging inside the palm's turn.

name: Spoolthwack
description: Grip the cord right behind the dart and hammer the weight down like a mallet.

name: Stamp Retrieve
description: Hook a loop over the collar or belt and pull the opponent off balance toward the dart.

name: Pluckzip
description: Step inside a swinging arm and press against the elbow with the short cord held between the fists.

name: Resolute Dartneck
description: Pin the cord between both hands across the throat and chest to block a grab.

name: Sprigspool
description: Wrap the cord round an arm at grappling range and haul it down with a pulse of qi.

name: Emberspool
description: Drive the dart's butt into the opponent's jaw as the cord draws their head forward.

name: Stalling Loopcast
description: Fling the cord over a spear's haft and let the dart's weight wind it round.

name: Reelinprop
description: A loop falls over the tip of a staff and tightens when the owner draws it back.

name: Ringend Stalk
description: Slip past the point of a long weapon and stand where its swing cannot turn.

name: Gall Spiralcast
description: Rake the cord down a shaft to push the weapon's tip into the ground.

name: Cordknot Scorer
description: Lift the dart over the shaft and let it drop onto the gripping hand.

name: Alert Tailring
description: Watch the long weapon's butt and shoulder to know which way its tip will travel.

name: Static Cordloop
description: Qi drives a hard pull on the tangled cord and wrenches the shaft out of the holder's hands.

name: Honed Flickhand
description: Send the dart sliding along a shaft so its point runs straight into the holder's knuckles.

name: Ember Snapback
description: Cast the dart along one unbroken line to the very end of the cord's reach.

name: Rill Whipout
description: Hop back to the edge of reach and throw as the feet land.

name: Thrumlinen
description: Lift the dart a hand's breadth and let its pull tell the exact distance to the mark.

name: Hungry Cordloop
description: Sweep the dart in a wide arc at shoulder height so it cuts across the opponent's whole front.

name: Poise Ringend
description: Snap the dart back across the body to knock aside a counter thrust.

name: Acrid Dartblade
description: Send two casts a half-beat apart so the second lands as the foe dodges the first.

name: Brisk Reelin
description: A surge of qi carries the dart a third farther than the arm alone could throw it.

name: Pluckthwack
description: Snap the dart back on a curved line so it cuts the opponent on the return.

name: Cordlength Carapace
description: Wrap a far limb at the end of the cast and drag the opponent a pace nearer.
